title: From Miletus to Alexandria: Greek Philosophy
dek: Of how Greek philosophy began in free trading cities, survived Athens's death sentence on Socrates, and found its safest home on a king's…

panels.label: Philosophers Tell It
panels.text: Reason freed itself from myth and grew by the force of its own arguments.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Philosophy grew where patrons protected it. Cities tolerated it until it touched their politics; kings paid for it when it served their prestige.

panels.label: The Tour
panels.text: 9 stops on the Chronosphere globe, from Miletus to Alexandria.
